title: Certina DS Action Diver
short_blurb: Certina diver in a 43 mm case, automatic. Automatic movement, so there is no battery to replace.
long_description:
Powermatic 80 movement and a 300 m rating. Reference numbers in this family are long and easily mistyped; confirm carefully.

300 m water resistance — swimmable, and rated for more than most owners will ask of it.
Sapphire crystal, which resists scratches far better than mineral glass.
